event.title: Community Clean-Up Day
event.description: Join your neighbours for our quarterly community clean-up day. Gloves, bags, and refreshments provided. All ages welcome.

event.title: Council Budget Information Session
event.description: Councillors will present the proposed 2026/27 budget and answer community questions. Light refreshments provided.

event.title: Digital Skills Workshop — Seniors
event.description: A hands-on workshop to help seniors use smartphones, video calls, and online services. Devices provided. Book early — limited spots.

event.title: CityLink Farmers Market
event.description: Browse fresh local produce, artisan goods, and handmade crafts from over 60 local vendors. Free entry, open to all.

event.title: Youth Leadership Forum
event.description: A full-day forum for young people aged 15–25 to connect with local leaders, develop skills, and shape the future of CityLink.

event.title: First Aid Essentials Course
event.description: Learn CPR, wound care, and emergency response basics in this half-day certified first aid course run by St John Ambulance.

event.title: ANZAC Day Dawn Service
event.description: Annual ANZAC Day Dawn Service to honour the service and sacrifice of Australian and New Zealand armed forces. All welcome.
